_comment: Optional. Copy to your Claude config directory as hbs-event-email-digest.config.json. Every field is auto-detected if omitted.
_audiences: Which audience labels to treat as relevant. Auto-detected from your mba20XX.hbs.edu address.
_showOtherAudiences: Show filtered-out events in a compact section at the bottom. Set false to hide them entirely.
_timeZone: Windows timezone name used when creating events. Only change this if the Student Event Calendar stops being Eastern.
_showAs: Free/busy status for created events: free, tentative, or busy.
